mapper.sql: o.domestic_order_id, o.account_id, o.domestic_product_id, o.stock_package_id, o.side, o.qty, o.price, o.amount, o.fee_amount, o.tax_amount, o.channel, o.idempotency_key, o.status, o.reject_reason, o.securities_trade_id, o.processed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domestic_order (account_id, domestic_product_id, stock_package_id, side, qty, price, amount, fee_amount, tax_amount, channel, idempotency_key, status, reject_reason, securities_trade_id, processed_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{domesticProductId}, #{stockPackageId}, #{side}, #{qty}, #{price}, #{amount}, #{feeAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{channel}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{securitiesTradeId}, #{processedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE domestic_order SET securities_recorded_at = NOW() WHERE domestic_order_id = #{domesticOrderId} AND securities_recorded_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT , p.ticker, c.ci_hash FROM domestic_order o JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE o.channel = 'CUSTOMER' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.securities_recorded_at IS NULL ORDER BY o.domestic_order_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT , p.ticker, p.name FROM domestic_order o JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT , p.ticker, p.name, p.type AS product_type, p.market FROM domestic_order o JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id WHERE o.stock_package_id = #{stockPackageId} AND o.channel = 'CUSTOMER' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' ORDER BY o.processed_at, o.domestic_order_id

SELECT , p.ticker, p.name, p.type AS product_type, p.market FROM domestic_order o JOIN stock_package sp ON sp.stock_package_id = o.stock_package_id JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id WHERE sp.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.channel = 'CUSTOMER' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' ORDER BY o.processed_at, o.domestic_order_id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(provisional_amount), 0) FROM krw_exchange WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND settlement_status = 'PROVISIONAL'

SELECT domestic_stock_balance_id, account_id, domestic_product_id, qty, status, last_purchase_date, avg_purchase_price FROM domestic_stock_balance WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND domestic_product_id = #{domesticProductId} ORDER BY domestic_stock_balance_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domestic_stock_balance (account_id, domestic_product_id, qty, status, last_purchase_date, avg_purchase_price) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{domesticProductId}, #{qty}, #{status}, #{lastPurchaseDate}, #{avgPurchasePrice})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT domestic_product_id FROM domestic_stock_balance WHERE qty > 0 ORDER BY domestic_product_id

SELECT domestic_stock_balance_id, account_id, domestic_product_id, qty, status, last_purchase_date, avg_purchase_price FROM domestic_stock_balance WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND qty > 0 ORDER BY domestic_product_id
mapper.update: UPDATE account a SET amount = a.amount + COALESCE(( SELECT o.amount FROM domestic_order o WHERE o.domestic_order_id = #{domesticOrderId} AND o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.status = 'EXECUTED'), 0) WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
